title: Junior Joining
statementMd:
![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/99cadab8cdcd74e76f0d8aff1c5145e33aa0ae4f.png)Patrol pair with shield and spear. Public Domain on publicdomainvectors (edited).

Arya, the Commander of Gil'ead, has received $2 \cdot n$ new recruits. Since the Gil'ead City Protectorate Council has mandated more patrols, she intends to pair them into $n$ pairs to patrol the area. To maximize the effectiveness of a patrol pair in the modern era, it should consist of one shield bearer and one spear carrier.

Each recruit $i$ has shield-defense skill $d_i$, and spear-attack skill $a_i$. While skilled usage of their respective tool is important, one should never neglect the effectiveness of strong synergy. Because of long-standing rivalries between cities, strong bonds have formed within each city. With enough discipline, Arya is sure that there will not be any bad blood within a pair, but if both are from the same city, they will synergize exceptionally well.

The total fighting strength of a pair is the sum of the shield-defense skill of one, the spear-attack skill of the other, and if both recruits are from the same city $c$, also a synergy bonus of $c$.

Determine the maximum sum of fighting strength over all pairs that Arya can achieve with optimal pairing.

## Input

The input consists of:

- One line with an integer $n$ ($1\leq n \leq 10^5$), half the number of new recruits.
- $2 \cdot n$ lines, the $i$th of which contains three integers $d_i$, $a_i$, and $c_i$ ($1 \leq d_i, a_i, c_i \leq 10^6$), the shield-defense skill, spear-attack skill, and the home city of the $i$th recruit.

## Output

Output the maximum achievable sum of fighting strength over all pairs.

## Note

In the first sample, there are only two recruits so they are paired together. Recruit $1$ is assigned the shield, recruit $2$ the spear. As they are not from the same city, only their skill is counted $4 + 2 = 6$.

In the second sample, recruit $3$ (shield) is paired with recruit $1$ (spear). As they are both from city $5$, they have $5$ bonus strength from synergy ($5 + 2 + 5 = 12$ total). Recruit $2$ (shield) and recruit $4$ (spear) are paired, resulting in a fighting strength of $6$.

In the third sample, one possible pairing is the following: recruit $3$ (shield) with $1$ (spear), and recruit $4$ (shield) with $2$ (spear).
statementZhMd:
![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/99cadab8cdcd74e76f0d8aff1c5145e33aa0ae4f.png)持盾与持矛的巡逻搭档。图片来自 publicdomainvectors，属于公有领域（经过编辑）。

Gil'ead 的指挥官 Arya 接收了 $2 \cdot n$ 名新兵。由于 Gil'ead 城市卫戍委员会要求增加巡逻，她打算将这些新兵分成 $n$ 对，在当地巡逻。为了最大限度地发挥现代巡逻搭档的效能，每对搭档应由一名持盾兵和一名持矛兵组成。

每名新兵 $i$ 的盾牌防御能力为 $d_i$，长矛攻击能力为 $a_i$。虽然熟练使用各自的武器很重要，但默契配合所带来的效果也不容忽视。由于城市之间长期存在竞争，来自同一座城市的人们形成了深厚的情谊。Arya 确信，只要纪律严明，每对搭档之间就不会产生嫌隙；而如果两人来自同一座城市，他们的配合将格外默契。

一对搭档的总战斗力，等于其中一人的盾牌防御能力与另一人的长矛攻击能力之和；如果两名新兵都来自同一座城市 $c$，还会额外获得 $c$ 的默契加成。

请确定 Arya 通过最优配对能够获得的所有搭档的战斗力总和的最大值。

## 输入格式

输入包含：

- 一行，包含一个整数 $n$（$1\leq n \leq 10^5$），表示新兵人数的一半。
- $2 \cdot n$ 行，其中第 $i$ 行包含三个整数 $d_i$、$a_i$ 和 $c_i$（$1 \leq d_i, a_i, c_i \leq 10^6$），分别表示第 $i$ 名新兵的盾牌防御能力、长矛攻击能力和家乡城市。

## 输出格式

输出所有搭档的战斗力总和的最大可能值。

## 说明

在第一个样例中，只有两名新兵，因此他们被配成一对。新兵 $1$ 被分配盾牌，新兵 $2$ 被分配长矛。由于他们来自不同的城市，只计算各自的能力，战斗力为 $4 + 2 = 6$。

在第二个样例中，新兵 $3$（持盾）与新兵 $1$（持矛）配对。由于他们都来自城市 $5$，因此获得 $5$ 的默契战斗力加成（总计 $5 + 2 + 5 = 12$）。新兵 $2$（持盾）与新兵 $4$（持矛）配对，战斗力为 $6$。

在第三个样例中，一种可行的配对方式如下：新兵 $3$（持盾）与新兵 $1$（持矛）配对，新兵 $4$（持盾）与新兵 $2$（持矛）配对。
